title: Ines and the Well
author: Lior Reyes
blurb: Mara Ashgrove, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
